Frequently Asked Questions

Everything you need to know before your first delivery.

From how Glow Meals works to menu updates, meal choices, dietary notes, subscriptions, and weekly order deadlines — here are the key things customers should know before ordering.

How does Glow Meals work? +
  • Glow Meals is a weekly organic meal delivery service designed to make healthy eating simple and convenient.
  • Choose a subscription plan, select your meals from the rotating menu, and receive fresh meals at your door each week.
  • Every order is prepared fresh using high-quality ingredients and arrives ready to enjoy.
What makes Glow Meals different? +
  • Real food made with ingredients you can feel good about.
  • Organic ingredients whenever possible and responsibly sourced proteins.
  • No industrial seed oils, no artificial preservatives, and fresh meals that are never frozen.
  • Seasonal ingredients, rotating menu features, and local suppliers whenever available.
How often does the menu change? +
  • The Glow Meals menu rotates every two weeks.
  • A new menu is released every other Sunday morning.
  • Customers can browse upcoming proteins, sides, salads, seasonal features, and add-ons before placing or updating orders.
Can I choose or customize my meals? +
  • Yes. You can select from available proteins, sides, salads, and seasonal features each week.
  • You can mix and match items to create meals that fit your lifestyle and dietary preferences.
  • Menu items may be labeled so customers can filter based on their preferences while ordering.
Vegan (V) Vegetarian (VG) Gluten-Free (GF) Dairy-Free when applicable
Do you accommodate food allergies or special dietary needs? +
  • Glow Meals provides detailed ingredient information and dietary filters to help customers make informed choices.
  • We do not currently offer customized meals, ingredient substitutions, or individualized allergy accommodations.
  • Meals are prepared in a kitchen that handles common allergens including dairy, eggs, nuts, soy, wheat, fish, and shellfish.
  • Because cross-contact is possible, we cannot guarantee that any meal is completely allergen-free.
What subscription plans and add-ons are available? +
  • Starter — 6 individual meals, perfect for individuals and busy professionals.
  • Most Loved — family-style meal prep with approximately 9 meals worth of food.
  • Family — large family-style meal prep with approximately 12–14 meals worth of food.
  • Optional add-ons include breakfast, bakery, fresh-pressed juices, and family-style protein add-ons.
  • Every subscription includes Glow Society membership at no additional cost.
When is the ordering deadline? +
  • Orders and meal updates for the upcoming delivery week must be submitted by Tuesday at 11:59 PM.
  • After the cutoff, meal selections are locked so the kitchen can source ingredients and begin production.
  • Plan changes, skips, pauses, cancellations, dietary preference updates, and delivery address changes must also be submitted before the Tuesday cutoff.
